brief: Turn your website into a money printer — 6 conversion patterns that pay you while you sleep.

slots.title: Erase Every Objection
slots.body: Remove risk with bold guarantees and trial offers. Shoppers buy faster when they feel safe.
slots.tipBody: Double your guarantee period to slash refunds.

slots.title: Stack The Upsell
slots.body: Offer a complementary upgrade right after the checkout click. Small bumps add 20–30% revenue instantly.
slots.tipBody: Price the bump at 15–30% of the main offer.

slots.title: Catch The Exit
slots.body: Trigger a last-chance offer when the mouse heads to close. This recaptures 10–15% of abandoning visitors.
slots.tipBody: Lead with a surprise discount, not an email gate.

slots.title: Add Real Scarcity
slots.body: Show genuine stock counters or limited-time deadlines. Urgency forces faster decisions than persuasion alone.
slots.tipBody: Never fake scarcity because trust dies when timers reset.

slots.title: Prove The Result
slots.body: Place recent sales notifications and star reviews near your buttons. Proof cuts doubt before it becomes hesitation.
slots.tipBody: Update timestamps to just now for maximum impact.

slots.title: Build Recurring Revenue
slots.body: Convert one-time buyers into monthly members with a value-packed subscription. Recurring cash smooths out feast-or-famine cycles.
slots.tipBody: Anchor the yearly plan at 2x the monthly price to nudge annual commits.

slots.body: Pick one pattern and deploy it before midnight. Your website should work while you sleep.
